description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named InstallApk, demonstrating package installation and uninstallation via Intents, including handling of APK files from assets, and managing installation results.

classes.name: InstallApk
classes.description: An Android Activity class demonstrating APK installation and uninstallation mechanisms.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up button click listeners for install/uninstall actions.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of install/uninstall actions, showing Toast messages accordingly.

methods.name: getApkUri
methods.description: Prepares a URI for the APK file, copying it from assets to internal storage and obtaining a content Uri via FileProvider or file Uri.
